Job Summary

Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees. The position provides the financial expertise to enable the successful implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives while maximizing the return on investment. In addition, creates and executes a business plan that is aligned with the property and brand’s business strategy and focuses on the execution of financial and accounting activities and the delivery of desirable financial results.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

4-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; 1 year experience in the finance and accounting or related professional area.

OR

Master's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; no work experience required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Assists in Conducting Strategic Planning and Decision Making

Assists in the development of means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.
Analyzes information, forecasts sales against expenses and creates annual budget plans.
Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.
Analyzes differences between actual budget wages and forecasted wages for more efficient budget planning.
Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
Assists in the creation of the annual operating budget for the property.
Provides analytical support during budget reviews to identify cost saving and productivity opportunities for property managers.
Assists in the implementation of a system of appropriate controls to manage business risks.
Ensures a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets, improve operations and profitability.
Analyzes financial data and market trends.
Assists in the development and implementation of a comprehensive annual business plan which is aligned with the company’s and brand’s strategic direction.
Provides on going analytical support by monitoring the operating department’s actual and projected sales.
Produces accurate forecasts that enable operations to react to changes in the business.

Leading Finance & Accounting Team

Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Communicates the strategic goals, the focus and the owner priorities to subordinates in a clear and precise manner.
Oversees internal, external and regulatory audit processes.
Provides excellent leadership by assigning team members clear accountability backed by appropriate authority.
Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.

Anticipating and Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders

Attends meetings and communicating with the owners, understanding the priorities and strategic focus.
Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc.).
Communicates financial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors.
Demonstrates an understanding of cash flow and owner priorities.
Manages communication with owners in an effective manner.
Manages property working capital and cash flow in accordance with brand SOPs and owner requirements.
Facilitates critique meetings to review information with management team.

Developing and Maintaining Finance and Accounting Goals

Ensures Profits and Losses are documented accurately.
Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.
Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
Develops and supports achievement of performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
Improves profit growth in operating departments.
Reviews audit issues to ensure accuracy.

Managing Projects and Policies

Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.
Reconciles balance sheet to ensure account balances are supported by appropriate documentation in accordance with SOPs.
Ensures that the P&L is accurate (e.g., costs are properly matched to revenue, costs are recorded in the proper accounts).
Ensures compliance with management contract and reporting requirements.
Ensures compliance with standard and local operating procedures (SOPs and LSOPs).
Ensures compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

Ensures team members are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
Ensures new hires participate in the department’s orientation program.
Ensures new hires receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Creates appropriate development plans which develop team members based on their individual strengths, development needs, career aspirations and abilities.
Conducts performance review process for employees
Participates in hiring activities as appropriate.

Job Summary

The Executive Assistant (“EA”) plays an important role in supporting the Chief Technology, Data & AI Officer (CTDAIO) and the day-to-day operations of the Information Technology Division. Reporting directly to the CTDAIO, the EA provides proactive administrative and operational support and works closely with the IT leadership team.

This role goes beyond day-to-day executive support. The EA will help the CTDAIO stay organized and focused across priorities related to technology, data, AI, cybersecurity, talent, and transformation. The successful candidate will anticipate what is needed, take ownership, use good judgment, and follow through on decisions and commitments.

What You Will Do

Note:
This role is required to work in the office full-time.

Executive & Divisional Support

Provide administrative support to the CTDAIO, including calendar management, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, correspondence, and preparation for executive, Board, committee, and divisional commitments.
Manage competing priorities and use good judgment to protect the CTDAIO’s time and keep attention focused on the most important issues.
Anticipate deadlines, decisions, dependencies, and potential issues; address what can be resolved independently and raise matters that require the CTDAIO’s attention.
Work with the IT leadership team and partners across the organization to clarify owners, actions, and timelines and follow up on commitments.
Prepare clear, accurate, and well-formatted materials to support decision-making.

Leadership Meetings & Follow-Through

Support the CTDAIO’s executive, Board, committee, and IT leadership responsibilities by coordinating schedules, agendas, materials, pre-reads, decisions, and follow-up.
Prepare and circulate meeting notes when needed, clearly capturing decisions, owners, timelines, and dependencies.
Track priorities and commitments, follow up to keep work moving, and flag items that are delayed or at risk.
Maintain executive and governance records in line with confidentiality, audit, and documentation requirements.
Work closely with Executive Assistants, committee secretaries, and partners across the organization to coordinate schedules, materials, and follow-up.

Expense and Administrative Support

Process invoices, expense claims, purchase documentation, and payments accurately and on time.
Track deadlines and follow up on missing information or approvals to keep administrative work on schedule.

Events, Engagement & Coordination

Coordinate IT leadership meetings, divisional calls, town halls, offsites, training sessions, and events, managing logistics and follow-up from start to finish.
Coordinate leadership updates, key messages, presentations, and opportunities to share team progress and innovation across the division.
Support activities that encourage ownership, accountability, collaboration, open communication, and continuous improvement.
Partner with other Executive Assistants and teams across the organization on shared initiatives, events, and executive priorities.

Relationship Management & Collaboration

Build strong working relationships with the CTDAIO, IT leaders, Executive Assistants, and stakeholders across the organization.
Help ensure information is clear, accurate, timely, and shared with the right people.
Use good judgment when handling sensitive issues and know when to act independently, seek input, or escalate.
Communicate directly and constructively and help resolve coordination gaps before they cause delays.

Ways of Working & Continuous Improvement

Handle confidential information with professionalism, discretion, and care.
Bring a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and follow-through to a fast-paced and changing environment.
Look for practical ways to simplify administrative processes and make work easier across the division.
Use Microsoft 365, AI, automation, and other available tools appropriately to improve productivity, quality, and responsiveness.
Contribute to a respectful, inclusive, and high-performing culture where expectations are clear and issues are addressed directly.

What You Bring

University or college education, or equivalent experience.
At least five years of executive administrative experience, including direct support to a C-suite or similarly senior executive in a complex organization.
Proven ability to manage complex calendars, competing priorities, executive meetings, confidential matters, and time-sensitive work with limited direction.
Experience supporting executive, Board, committee, or senior leadership meetings, including coordinating agendas and materials, taking minutes, capturing decisions, and tracking actions.
Experience with vendor administration, invoices, expense claims, purchase documentation, and related tracking.
Advanced skills in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint. Experience using AI and automation tools is an asset.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage several priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear, accurate, and polished executive materials.
A proactive and practical approach, with the confidence to take ownership, work independently, ask questions, and respectfully challenge when needed.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective relationships at all levels of the organization.
Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential information.
Adaptability, resilience, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
Alignment with HOOPP’s values and a commitment to fostering an accountable, collaborative, respectful, and positive workplace.

The actual base salary offered to the successful candidate may vary based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, individual's expertise and level of experience applicable to the role they are being offered.

jobs.description:
About The Lacroix Medical Group

A leader in private medicine in Quebec, the Lacroix Medical Group
comprises three rapidly growing divisions:

Medical Clinics
Operating Rooms
Biomedical Laboratory

Since its founding in 2009, the Lacroix Medical Group has experienced sustained growth and now has nearly 350 employees across its various divisions. Driven by an ambitious and entrepreneurial vision, the organization continues its expansion across the province and aspires to accelerate its development in national and international markets.

OUR MISSION

To be the benchmark in private healthcare.

OUR VALUES

Passion | Respect | Integrity | Commitment | Innovation

Mandate

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, the Digital Performance Manager
plays a key role in the growth, reach, and success of the Lacroix Medical Group.

Passionate about digital marketing, data, and innovation, this individual leverages their expertise to develop high-performing strategies that generate a tangible impact on our business objectives. Their daily challenge: transforming data into opportunities, strategies into results, and ideas into measurable actions. In a dynamic environment encompassing multiple clinics, services, and business lines, the successful candidate will lead the organization's overall digital performance. They will develop, deploy, measure, and optimize digital media campaigns to increase our visibility, generate business opportunities, and maximize the return on our marketing investments. A true strategic partner to internal teams, this proactive individual will work closely with various stakeholders to understand their challenges, identify the best growth opportunities, and recommend innovative, results-oriented solutions. Thanks to her expertise, she actively contributes to the evolution of our digital maturity, the continuous improvement of our practices, and the achievement of our growth ambitions. Curious, analytical, and always on the lookout for new trends, the Digital Performance Manager enjoys experimenting, innovating, and pushing boundaries. Whether through campaign optimization, advanced data analytics, artificial intelligence, geolocation, or new approaches to digital marketing, this individual helps maintain the Lacroix Medical Group's position among the most innovative organizations in its sector. If you are performance-driven, thrive on challenges, and want to grow in an environment where your ideas will have a concrete and measurable impact, this position is for you. Your Role Take charge of the activation, management, and analysis of digital media campaigns (SEM, programmatic, and social media). Ensure the implementation of trafficking, online deployment, execution, daily bid monitoring, campaign health, and performance analysis. Manage and ensure adherence to media budgets while optimizing ROI. investments. Support internal clients, understand their needs, advise them, and recommend the best digital strategies. Ensure rigorous monitoring of conversions, data quality, and overall campaign performance. In-depth analysis of results, identify optimization opportunities, and share learnings with team members. Effectively navigate between multiple projects, brands, and priorities simultaneously. Manage and optimize Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns to achieve established performance objectives. Utilize measurement and optimization tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and SEMrush. Design, maintain, and analyze performance dashboards in Looker Studio. Constantly monitor best practices in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Search Engine Optimization (SEO). Participate to the development, implementation, and execution of digital strategies with the team's various experts. Identify and recommend new acquisition, conversion, and optimization opportunities to support the organization's growth.

The Ideal Candidate

Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or a related field.
Minimum of 6 to 8 years of experience in digital marketing and performance campaign management.
Experience in an environment encompassing multiple divisions, brands, or business lines.
Agency experience (a significant asset).
Valid Google Ads certification.
Excellent command of Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, and Looker Studio.
Experience with other platforms and tools, including Google Tag Manager and TikTok Ads Manager.
Strong analytical skills and a strong results orientation.
Highly autonomous, rigorous, and organized.
Initiative and ability to thrive in a constantly evolving environment.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a context of rapid growth.
Excellent command of both spoken and written French and English.
Strong interest in innovation, artificial intelligence, and the evolution of digital technologies.

Our Benefits

Lacroix Gift Card of $500 per year, including fast access to a doctor.
Annual Health Account of $1,100, which can reach $2,000 based on years of service. FTQ Workers' Fund with employer contribution. Annual budget dedicated to continuing education. Real opportunities for career advancement and professional development. Three weeks of vacation upon hiring. Four paid floating holidays per year. Hybrid work model. Free parking. Modern, bright, and collaborative work environment. Unlimited coffee and employee lounge. Join an ambitious, growing organization where your expertise, ideas, and passion will directly contribute to shaping the future of private healthcare. Quebec.

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101490

Position Overview

The Sr. Director Product & Platform Trust is accountable for shaping how Autodesk product teams build safe and secure products at scale. The Senior Director, Product & Platform Trust will partner closely with product and engineering leaders across Autodesk's product & platform divisions to understand their development environments, security needs, and emerging challenges, and systemic barriers to timely remediation. They will translate those insights into a coherent product security strategy and scalable capabilities that help teams prevent security issues, identify them earlier, and remediate them efficiently within their engineering workflows.

You will lead an organization spanning application security, trust engineering, and product management including product-team enablement. Together, these teams will develop the tools, platforms, practices, guidance, and expertise that embed security throughout the product development lifecycle and make secure development easier and more consistent for Autodesk teams.

Reporting to the Chief Trust Officer, you will influence product and engineering strategy across a highly distributed, matrixed organization. Success in this role means building trusted partnerships with product organizations, defining the right security capabilities, driving adoption, and enabling teams to increasingly build security and trust into the software development lifecycle.

This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional leadership role requiring strong product and engineering judgment, deep product security expertise, and the ability to drive change through influence across a global organization.

Responsibilities

Define and lead Autodesk's product security strategy, with a focus on enabling product teams to develop safe and secure products and services at scale
Build deep partnerships with senior product and engineering leaders across Autodesk's product divisions to understand their architectures, development models, priorities, and security challenges
Define the security capabilities, practices, and services Autodesk product teams need across the development lifecycle, balancing common enterprise capabilities with the needs of diverse product and technology environments
Lead application security strategy, including threat modeling and secure coding practices, application security testing, penetration testing, and other product security capabilities that help teams prevent and address security issues throughout the development lifecycle
Lead Product Security Engineering and Product Management to create a clear capability roadmap and deliver scalable tooling, platforms, integrations, automation, and paved roads that fit naturally into engineering workflows
Drive adoption and enablement so that security capabilities are usable and effective, and product teams have the knowledge, guidance, and support needed to incorporate security into day-to-day development
Create a strong feedback loop between Autodesk's product organizations and Product Security, using developer needs, emerging threats, technology changes, and security insights to continuously evolve priorities and capabilities
Partner with Vulnerability Management and Autodesk product organizations to understand systemic barriers to remediation and develop scalable capabilities, automation, and engineering practices that enable product teams to remediate security issues efficiently and sustainably
Define and measure outcomes that demonstrate adoption, effectiveness, and improvements in secure development across Autodesk
Build, develop, and retain a high-performing, globally distributed organization spanning security expertise, engineering, product management, and enablement

Minimum Qualifications

12+ years of experience in product security, application security, secure software development, security engineering, or related disciplines, including significant leadership experience
Demonstrated experience leading product or application security at scale in a complex software, SaaS, cloud, or technology organization
Proven ability to partner with senior product and engineering executives across multiple business or product organizations and influence strategy without relying on direct authority
Experience translating product security needs into a capability strategy and roadmap, and leading teams that build or deliver security tooling, platforms, services, integrations, or developer-facing capabilities
Experience improving security remediation at scale by addressing developer workflow, tooling, automation, or other systemic barriers
Strong understanding of modern software development practices, cloud and platform architectures, secure software development lifecycle practices, and application security techniques
Experience leading multidisciplinary organizations that include security practitioners and engineering and/or product management functions
Track record of driving adoption and organizational change across large, distributed engineering environments, with a focus on measurable outcomes rather than activity alone
Exceptional communication and executive-influence skills, with the ability to translate complex security topics into clear product, engineering, and business decisions
Experience building, developing, and retaining senior technical and leadership talent across globally distributed teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building developer-facing security platforms, paved roads, shared services, or self-service capabilities used across multiple product organizations
Experience operating in heterogeneous technology environments where security capabilities must support different architectures, development models, and product needs
Knowledge of emerging product security challenges related to cloud-native architectures, software supply chain security, AI-enabled development, and AI-powered products
Experience using product management practices, customer or developer research, and adoption metrics to shape security capability investments
External credibility in product security, application security, or secure software development through industry participation, thought leadership, standards work, or peer networks
Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Job Summary

The Executive Assistant (“EA”) plays an important role in supporting the Chief Technology, Data & AI Officer (CTDAIO) and the day-to-day operations of the Information Technology Division. Reporting directly to the CTDAIO, the EA provides proactive administrative and operational support and works closely with the IT leadership team.

This role goes beyond day-to-day executive support. The EA will help the CTDAIO stay organized and focused across priorities related to technology, data, AI, cybersecurity, talent, and transformation. The successful candidate will anticipate what is needed, take ownership, use good judgment, and follow through on decisions and commitments.

What You Will Do

Note:
This role is required to work in the office full-time.

Executive & Divisional Support

Provide administrative support to the CTDAIO, including calendar management, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, correspondence, and preparation for executive, Board, committee, and divisional commitments.
Manage competing priorities and use good judgment to protect the CTDAIO’s time and keep attention focused on the most important issues.
Anticipate deadlines, decisions, dependencies, and potential issues; address what can be resolved independently and raise matters that require the CTDAIO’s attention.
Work with the IT leadership team and partners across the organization to clarify owners, actions, and timelines and follow up on commitments.
Prepare clear, accurate, and well-formatted materials to support decision-making.

Leadership Meetings & Follow-Through

Support the CTDAIO’s executive, Board, committee, and IT leadership responsibilities by coordinating schedules, agendas, materials, pre-reads, decisions, and follow-up.
Prepare and circulate meeting notes when needed, clearly capturing decisions, owners, timelines, and dependencies.
Track priorities and commitments, follow up to keep work moving, and flag items that are delayed or at risk.
Maintain executive and governance records in line with confidentiality, audit, and documentation requirements.
Work closely with Executive Assistants, committee secretaries, and partners across the organization to coordinate schedules, materials, and follow-up.

Expense and Administrative Support

Process invoices, expense claims, purchase documentation, and payments accurately and on time.
Track deadlines and follow up on missing information or approvals to keep administrative work on schedule.

Events, Engagement & Coordination

Coordinate IT leadership meetings, divisional calls, town halls, offsites, training sessions, and events, managing logistics and follow-up from start to finish.
Coordinate leadership updates, key messages, presentations, and opportunities to share team progress and innovation across the division.
Support activities that encourage ownership, accountability, collaboration, open communication, and continuous improvement.
Partner with other Executive Assistants and teams across the organization on shared initiatives, events, and executive priorities.

Relationship Management & Collaboration

Build strong working relationships with the CTDAIO, IT leaders, Executive Assistants, and stakeholders across the organization.
Help ensure information is clear, accurate, timely, and shared with the right people.
Use good judgment when handling sensitive issues and know when to act independently, seek input, or escalate.
Communicate directly and constructively and help resolve coordination gaps before they cause delays.

Ways of Working & Continuous Improvement

Handle confidential information with professionalism, discretion, and care.
Bring a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and follow-through to a fast-paced and changing environment.
Look for practical ways to simplify administrative processes and make work easier across the division.
Use Microsoft 365, AI, automation, and other available tools appropriately to improve productivity, quality, and responsiveness.
Contribute to a respectful, inclusive, and high-performing culture where expectations are clear and issues are addressed directly.

What You Bring

University or college education, or equivalent experience.
At least five years of executive administrative experience, including direct support to a C-suite or similarly senior executive in a complex organization.
Proven ability to manage complex calendars, competing priorities, executive meetings, confidential matters, and time-sensitive work with limited direction.
Experience supporting executive, Board, committee, or senior leadership meetings, including coordinating agendas and materials, taking minutes, capturing decisions, and tracking actions.
Experience with vendor administration, invoices, expense claims, purchase documentation, and related tracking.
Advanced skills in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint. Experience using AI and automation tools is an asset.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage several priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear, accurate, and polished executive materials.
A proactive and practical approach, with the confidence to take ownership, work independently, ask questions, and respectfully challenge when needed.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective relationships at all levels of the organization.
Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential information.
Adaptability, resilience, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
Alignment with HOOPP’s values and a commitment to fostering an accountable, collaborative, respectful, and positive workplace.

new_jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101490

Position Overview

The Sr. Director Product & Platform Trust is accountable for shaping how Autodesk product teams build safe and secure products at scale. The Senior Director, Product & Platform Trust will partner closely with product and engineering leaders across Autodesk's product & platform divisions to understand their development environments, security needs, and emerging challenges, and systemic barriers to timely remediation. They will translate those insights into a coherent product security strategy and scalable capabilities that help teams prevent security issues, identify them earlier, and remediate them efficiently within their engineering workflows.

You will lead an organization spanning application security, trust engineering, and product management including product-team enablement. Together, these teams will develop the tools, platforms, practices, guidance, and expertise that embed security throughout the product development lifecycle and make secure development easier and more consistent for Autodesk teams.

Reporting to the Chief Trust Officer, you will influence product and engineering strategy across a highly distributed, matrixed organization. Success in this role means building trusted partnerships with product organizations, defining the right security capabilities, driving adoption, and enabling teams to increasingly build security and trust into the software development lifecycle.

This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional leadership role requiring strong product and engineering judgment, deep product security expertise, and the ability to drive change through influence across a global organization.

Responsibilities

Define and lead Autodesk's product security strategy, with a focus on enabling product teams to develop safe and secure products and services at scale
Build deep partnerships with senior product and engineering leaders across Autodesk's product divisions to understand their architectures, development models, priorities, and security challenges
Define the security capabilities, practices, and services Autodesk product teams need across the development lifecycle, balancing common enterprise capabilities with the needs of diverse product and technology environments
Lead application security strategy, including threat modeling and secure coding practices, application security testing, penetration testing, and other product security capabilities that help teams prevent and address security issues throughout the development lifecycle
Lead Product Security Engineering and Product Management to create a clear capability roadmap and deliver scalable tooling, platforms, integrations, automation, and paved roads that fit naturally into engineering workflows
Drive adoption and enablement so that security capabilities are usable and effective, and product teams have the knowledge, guidance, and support needed to incorporate security into day-to-day development
Create a strong feedback loop between Autodesk's product organizations and Product Security, using developer needs, emerging threats, technology changes, and security insights to continuously evolve priorities and capabilities
Partner with Vulnerability Management and Autodesk product organizations to understand systemic barriers to remediation and develop scalable capabilities, automation, and engineering practices that enable product teams to remediate security issues efficiently and sustainably
Define and measure outcomes that demonstrate adoption, effectiveness, and improvements in secure development across Autodesk
Build, develop, and retain a high-performing, globally distributed organization spanning security expertise, engineering, product management, and enablement

Minimum Qualifications

12+ years of experience in product security, application security, secure software development, security engineering, or related disciplines, including significant leadership experience
Demonstrated experience leading product or application security at scale in a complex software, SaaS, cloud, or technology organization
Proven ability to partner with senior product and engineering executives across multiple business or product organizations and influence strategy without relying on direct authority
Experience translating product security needs into a capability strategy and roadmap, and leading teams that build or deliver security tooling, platforms, services, integrations, or developer-facing capabilities
Experience improving security remediation at scale by addressing developer workflow, tooling, automation, or other systemic barriers
Strong understanding of modern software development practices, cloud and platform architectures, secure software development lifecycle practices, and application security techniques
Experience leading multidisciplinary organizations that include security practitioners and engineering and/or product management functions
Track record of driving adoption and organizational change across large, distributed engineering environments, with a focus on measurable outcomes rather than activity alone
Exceptional communication and executive-influence skills, with the ability to translate complex security topics into clear product, engineering, and business decisions
Experience building, developing, and retaining senior technical and leadership talent across globally distributed teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building developer-facing security platforms, paved roads, shared services, or self-service capabilities used across multiple product organizations
Experience operating in heterogeneous technology environments where security capabilities must support different architectures, development models, and product needs
Knowledge of emerging product security challenges related to cloud-native architectures, software supply chain security, AI-enabled development, and AI-powered products
Experience using product management practices, customer or developer research, and adoption metrics to shape security capability investments
External credibility in product security, application security, or secure software development through industry participation, thought leadership, standards work, or peer networks
Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
